data.description: Penthouse | Heart of Marina | Renovation Project
data.display_address: The Jewel Tower B, The Jewels, Dubai Marina, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience refined waterfront living in this exceptional triplex residence at The Jewels Tower B, thoughtfully designed for those seeking space, privacy, and luxury. Featuring elegant interiors, expansive living and dining areas, and floor-to-ceiling windows, this home is filled with natural light and offers a sophisticated atmosphere throughout.

The highlight of this stunning residence is the private rooftop pool on the third floor, creating the perfect setting for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying panoramic surroundings. The well-planned layout provides generous indoor and outdoor spaces, making it ideal for families who value both comfort and exclusivity.

Located in one of Dubai Marina's most desirable waterfront communities, residents enjoy easy access to the marina promenade, fine dining, retail destinations, and major road networks. This is a rare opportunity to own a distinctive home that combines elegance, convenience, and an exceptional lifestyle.

Property Features:
- 4 Spacious Bedrooms
- 6 Bathrooms
- 9,076.02 Sq. Ft.
- Private Rooftop Pool
- Maid's Room
- 3 Parking Spaces
- Dedicated Driver's Room in the Parking Area
- Bright Living and Dining Areas
- Premium Waterfront Community
